description: This file defines the KeycloakUserService class, which provides methods to create, update, and read user data via Keycloak's API in the context of an internet banking application.

classes.name: KeycloakUserService
classes.description: Service class for managing Keycloak users, including creation, update, and retrieval operations.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Creates a new user in Keycloak using the provided UserRepresentation object and returns the HTTP response status.

methods.name: updateUser
methods.description: Updates an existing user in Keycloak based on the provided UserRepresentation.

methods.name: readUserByEmail
methods.description: Searches for users by email and returns a list of matching UserRepresentation objects.

methods.name: readUser
methods.description: Retrieves a user by ID, throws EntityNotFoundException if the user is not found.
